question: Who among the following was the renowned poet-saint of the Bhakti movement known for composing dohas (couplets)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kabir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kabir** was a prominent poet-saint of the **Bhakti movement**, known for his devotional and philosophical poetry.
 
• He composed **dohas** (couplets), which are short and meaningful verses that convey profound spiritual truths in a simple language.
 
• Kabir was born in the 15th century in **Varanasi** (modern-day Uttar Pradesh, India), though his exact birth year is uncertain.
 
• He strongly opposed the rigid practices of both **Hinduism** and **Islam** and emphasized a universal path to spirituality.
 
• Kabir’s teachings revolved around the concepts of **love, unity, equality, and devotion to the Supreme Being**.
 
• His works are included in the **Guru Granth Sahib**, the holy scripture of Sikhism.
 
• Some of his famous dohas include teachings about **self-realization, truth, and the futility of rituals**.
 
• Kabir’s philosophy is often seen as a blend of **Hindu Bhakti** and **Sufi mysticism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bhasa**__

 __
 
• **Bhasa** was a classical **Sanskrit dramatist** and one of the earliest known Indian playwrights.
 
• He is believed to have lived before Kalidasa, possibly around the 3rd century CE.
 
• Some of his most famous works include **Swapnavasavadatta** and **Uru-Bhanga**.
 
• Bhasa's works are known for their simplicity and innovative themes.
 
 
 
• **Kalidasa**__
 __
 
• **Kalidasa** was a renowned **classical Sanskrit poet and dramatist**.
 
• He is often regarded as the **Shakespeare of India**.
 
• Some of his famous works include **Abhijnana Shakuntalam**, **Meghaduta**, and **Raghuvamsa**.
 
• Kalidasa’s poetry and plays often revolve around themes of **love and nature**.
 
 
 
• **Bharavi**__
 
 
• **Bharavi** was a 6th-century **Sanskrit poet** known for his epic poem **Kiratarjuniya**.
 
• The poem is based on an episode from the **Mahabharata**, where Arjuna meets Lord Shiva in the guise of a hunter.
 
• Bharavi’s work is celebrated for its **rich vocabulary** and **complex style**.
